summary: Whole-game interaction acceptance (r1). I drove the real game at 1920x1080, with spot checks at 1280x720 and 2560x1440, in three ways: keyboard only (fresh profile, no autoplay flag), mouse only, and a fake standard gamepad polled by core Input, plus window.__br. There were 12 probes; logs and sheets are in shots/accept/r1-interaction/ (probe-*.log, s1-s7.jpg). What works: every screen is reachable and backs out with Esc, Backspace, pad B or the clickable ESC hint. Focus is always visible and fully on screen at all three sizes. The overflow audit is clean except one title glyph. Garage buy/equip works, and so does every settings row: volumes, quality low/medium/high through the restart offer (verified after the reload: low turns AA off), shake, auto-pedal, slow-mo, and a complete save reset. Pause resume/restart/quit, results -> 下一站, and career unlock/next all work, and all of it persists across a reload. Audio unlocks on the first key or click. With prefers-reduced-motion set, no UI animation runs and the credits stop scrolling. Mashing never double-starts a race or leaves the game stuck: Enter mashed through title -> race, Esc mashed in menus and in the race, restart-confirm spam, double and triple clicks. Pausing and quitting during a KO restore the clock. renderer memory stays flat over 5 restarts. The r2 results-mash fix holds for Space every 450 ms and pad B every 220 ms. 0 console errors and tsc clean. Not a pass, because of two majors. (1) The pad d-pad does not steer, although HOW TO promises it, so stickless pads cannot play. (2) Winning the final career event shows a 'you need top 3' toast, and nothing marks a cup clear or a career clear. Minors: the HUD shows keyboard glyphs to pad players; START does nothing on the title; a click can hit the results row the instant it arms; key art pops in late on a cold start; quitting a career race returns to the main menu; the intro skip is unhinted and a restart takes 6-9 s; Tab and right-click are unhandled; there is no in-game motion option; ordered value rows wrap; there is no achievements screen; there is no in-game quit; a title glyph is clipped. There is no character select, by design: SPEC makes the pelican the only playable hero.

issues.title: Gamepad d-pad does not steer in a race, although HOW TO promises it ('转向（十字键 ←→ 亦可）')
issues.detail: probe-l.log: fake standard pad, coast seed 4, traffic off, at speed. Holding d-pad right (button 15) or left (14) for 0.9 s leaves input.steer = 0 and lateral x unchanged (dx 0.00). In the same window the left stick moves the bike 6.2 m and ArrowRight 2.7 m. Input.update() builds steering only from axes[0] (padSteer) and keyboard keys (isKeyDown); the pad 'left'/'right' actions from PADMAP 14/15 only reach the menus. data/strings.ts HOWTO_GAMEPAD documents d-pad steering. Pads without sticks (8BitDo SN30/Zero, arcade sticks in d-pad mode) cannot steer at all.
issues.fix: src/core/input.ts update(): when |padSteer| is 0, take a digital steer from padDown.has('right') - padDown.has('left'). Merge it with kbSteer and ramp it with the same STEER_RISE/STEER_FALL, including the instant reversal through centre. Add a core-check case: fake pad, d-pad right moves the player's x.

issues.title: Career finale dead end: winning the last event shows a failure toast, and no cup or career clear is ever marked
issues.detail: probe-h.log, keyboard, save career.unlocked=9: 巡回赛 -> ★★★落日山道 -> finish 1ST. The results show only '首次完赛 FIRST FINISH', and 下一站 is greyed out. Pressing 下一站 toasts '前三名才能解锁下一站' to the winner. nextRace() returns null because CAREER[9] does not exist, and the disabled button reuses the not-top-3 onDenied. The toast lands on the winner's speech bubble (s5.jpg, h-finale-results.png). A cup clear (event 3/6) shows only the unlock tag. Finishing the whole 巡回赛 brings no trophy or stamp, no credits roll, no reward and no achievement (data/achievements.ts has none for cups or the career). The main mode ends in a dead end with wrong text.
issues.fix: results-flow.ts/results.ts: when a top-3 finish lands on a cup's last event (ev.index % 3 === 0), stamp '<杯名> CLEAR' in the title row. On the final event (ev.index === CAREER.length), stamp '巡回赛通关 CAREER CLEAR', and replace 下一站 with '通关!' leading to credits (props {finale:true}) or a short trophy card. Give the disabled 下一站 an accurate denial per case: '已经是最后一站了' vs '前三名才能解锁下一站'. Request cup/career-clear copy and an achievement from content.

issues.title: In-race HUD shows keyboard glyphs to gamepad players (U/I/O, P, 'SHOWTIME READY [P]')
issues.detail: In pad mode the menus, hint bars and pause sheet switch to A/B/RT…, but the HUD stays on keyboard glyphs. The skill diamonds read U/I/O, the ult reads P, and the SP bar reads 'SHOWTIME READY [P]' (hud/skills.ts KEYS=['U','I','O'] and 'P'; cluster.ts kbd 'P'). s7.jpg is a crop of c-race-pad.png: 'O' under 翼 and a yellow 'P' under 天 while the player drives with a pad. SHOWTIME is bound to R3 (stick click), the least discoverable button. So at the one moment the HUD prompts the player to act, it names a key the player does not have. Related keyboard-only copy: HOWTO_BASICS '攒满 SP 就按 P'; menu blurb 'J 往左扇，L 往右扇'.
issues.fix: Render both glyphs in the HUD key badges (LB / ✚↑ / ✚↓, R3, Y), like ui-screens' keyGlyph(). Toggle them with the .is-pad class the shell already sets on .br-ui, so the prompt follows app.input.lastDevice live. Ask content and ui-screens for device-neutral copy.

issues.title: START does nothing on the title screen (and acts as nothing in menus)
issues.detail: probe-c.log: on '按任意键 PRESS ANY KEY', START (button 9) and B leave the screen on the title after 0.9 s; only A proceeds. title.ts onAction rejects 'pause', which is START's only action, together with 'back'. START is the first button most pad players press on a title screen. In the main menu, START also does nothing.
issues.fix: title.ts: proceed on 'pause' as well. Keep ignoring only 'back' (Esc/Backspace/B, via isDown('back')). Optionally treat START as confirm on the main menu.

issues.title: Results: a mouse click can fire a button the instant the action row arms
issues.detail: probe-e.log, coast quick race, 1920x1080: I clicked every ~230 ms on the bottom-left spot where the hidden row waits (x≈298, y≈978; pointer-events none until armed). The row armed at 2173 ms. The next click, at 2316 ms (143 ms later), fired flow:restartRace. The row slides in, so the button under the cursor even changed mid-slide. Clicks never reset the shell's press clock (sincePress counts only key/pad actions). So a mouse user who clicks to hurry the stamp and count-up arms the row under their own click. Also, clicking the stage does not skip the show; only the small ENTER hint does.
issues.fix: shell.ts: call notePress() on pointerdown inside .br-screens, so clicks delay arming the way key presses do. results.ts: ignore pointer activation on the row for ~350 ms after .is-armed (or until its slide-in ends), and let a click anywhere on the stage call skipShow().

issues.title: Key art pops in after the screen is revealed (black title panel, empty menu frame on a cold start)
issues.detail: With a fresh profile, probe A's title shot (600 ms after the title settled) shows the right art panel solid black (a-title.png, s1.jpg). Probe B's menu at 1280x720, ~1.5 s after the reveal, shows the empty black hero frame (b-menu-720.png, s2.jpg). title.webp (649 KB, 2752 px) is requested only when the title is built; in probe K the request finished at 2.6 s. menu.webp is requested only when the menu is built. artImage() makes an with no preload, and the screens' ready promise does not wait for it, so the wipe reveals an empty frame.
issues.fix: Preload and decode ART.title/menu/garage and LOADING_ART during boot: boot's ready = Promise.all(img.decode()), capped at ~1.5 s. In title/menu/garage, set ready = img.decode() with a timeout, so the shell reveals the screen with its art in place.

issues.title: Quitting a career race from pause lands on the main menu, not the career ladder
issues.detail: probe-i.log I2: career event -> Esc -> 退出比赛 -> 退出 ends on 'menu'. The results screen sends career races back to the ladder (results-flow leaveRace). pause.ts instead emits flow:quitRace, and core/game.ts answers that with show('menu'). The player has to open 巡回赛 again and find the event.
issues.fix: pause.ts leaveRace('quit'): after emitting flow:quitRace, call ctx.go('career') when session.config.mode === 'career'. The router is latest-wins; results-flow already relies on that. Also remember('career', <event index>).

issues.title: The intro flyover can be skipped, but nothing says so
issues.detail: race/flow.ts skips the ~3 s intro on 'confirm', but the intro cards show no skip prompt: the track title card and the rival cards (i-intro.png, s6.jpg, s7.jpg). The probe-i HUD text dump has no hint either. Players sit through the flyover every race and on every restart.
issues.fix: Add a small P5 chip 'ENTER / A 跳过' to the intro cards (pad glyph via .is-pad), bottom-right. Fade it in after ~0.5 s and remove it when the countdown starts.

issues.title: Restart takes 6-9 s to give back control (forced 2 s loading card on the same track)
issues.detail: probe-i.log I1: pause -> 重新开始 -> 重来. Control (phase racing) returns after 8.9 s when the intro plays, and 5.9 s when it is skipped with Enter. loading.ts holds the card for at least 2.0 s (MIN_SHOW_MS) even when restarting the track that was just loaded, whose tip the player has already read. A commercial arcade racer restarts in ~3-4 s.
issues.fix: loading.ts: on a restart or 再来一局 (same trackId as the previous config), use a short hold (~500 ms; MIN_SHOW_DIRECT_MS exists). Optional race request: start a restarted race at the countdown.

issues.title: Tab and right-click are not handled in the browser build
issues.detail: probe-i.log I0: the page has 0 focusable elements, and a Tab keydown is not prevented (input.ts only prevents KEYMAP codes). In a desktop browser, Tab therefore moves focus to the browser chrome. The race auto-pauses on blur, and the menus stop answering keys until the player clicks the page. Many PC racers bind Tab to the scoreboard. probe-b.log B6: a contextmenu event on the UI is not prevented, so a right-click pops the browser menu over the game. Right-click and the mouse back button never act as 'back' in menus.
issues.fix: input.ts attach(): preventDefault on 'Tab'. main.ts: preventDefault 'contextmenu' on the canvas and #ui. Offer ui-screens an onAction('back') path for right-click and mouse button 3 on menu screens.

issues.title: No in-game reduced-motion / flash option (OS setting only)
issues.detail: Settings (settings-rows.ts ROWS) has no motion row. Only the OS prefers-reduced-motion query is honoured: the tokens.css kill-switch, fx/state.ts reducedFlashes, and camera/rig.ts shake ×0.35. probe-g.log confirms that path works: 0 running UI animations, the credits stay still, and the KO still plays. A player who has not set the OS flag cannot calm the constant 12 fps jitter, slams, flash frames or chromatic punch from inside the game. Shake and slow-mo can be turned down; flashes and UI motion cannot.
issues.fix: Add a '动态效果 MOTION' row (跟随系统 / 减弱 / 完整) saved in save.settings (core request: Settings.motion). Toggle .is-reduced on .br-ui so the existing CSS kill-switch applies. fx and camera should read the setting alongside the media query.

issues.title: Settings: ordered value rows wrap around (画质 高 -> 低), and a meter cannot be clicked to 0
issues.detail: probe-a.log B1: pressing → on 画质 '高' jumps to '低', and 慢镜头 '关闭' to '完整'. Ordered scales wrap, so a player tapping → to max out quality drops it to low, and then gets a restart prompt. probe-b.log B4: clicking the first master tick sets 10 %; 0 (mute) is reachable only through ◀.
issues.fix: settings-rows.ts: clamp steps on ordered rows (quality, slowmo) and keep wrapping only for 2-option toggles. meter: make a click on the already-active first tick (or a small mute pill) set 0.

issues.title: No achievements / records screen: unlocks are visible only on the results screen that earned them
issues.detail: data/achievements.ts defines about 40 achievements, and gameplay/achievements saves them. Their only appearance is the chips on the results screen that unlocked them (results-achievements.ts). The screen registry has no list of earned and locked achievements, no completion count, and no per-track best times, so a player cannot see what is left to do. Polished stylised racers always ship a records/achievements page.
issues.fix: Add a 成就 ACHIEVEMENTS page (a menu entry, or a tab on the career screen). Show a grid of all definitions: earned ones with icon, name and desc; locked ones with a silhouette and desc. Add an 'N/40' counter and per-track bests.

issues.title: No way to quit from inside the game; the desktop shell drops the macOS app menu (Quit accelerator)
issues.detail: The main menu (ui/copy.ts MENU) has no 退出游戏 entry, and Esc on the menu only returns to the title. desktop/main.cjs calls Menu.setApplicationMenu(null). On macOS the default app menu provides the Quit/Hide/Copy accelerators (Cmd+Q, Cmd+H), so those are gone too. In F11 fullscreen, the player has to leave fullscreen and click the window's close button.
issues.fix: desktop/main.cjs: on macOS set a minimal app menu with role 'appMenu' (quit/hide) instead of null. Expose window.brDesktop.quit() through a preload, and have ui-screens show a '退出游戏 QUIT' menu entry (with a confirm) only when that bridge exists.

issues.title: Title logo glyph clipped by the top edge of the screen
issues.detail: probe-f.log overflow audit: the white ransom box of '鹕' in the title's 暴力鹈鹕 starts 25 px above the viewport at 1280x720 and 50 px above at 2560x1440. The stage scales with the window, so it is cut at every size; s3.jpg shows the box sliced by the top edge. Every other screen passed the overflow and focus audits at 1280x720 and 2560x1440, HUD, pause and results included.
issues.fix: title.css: move .br-title-logo down ~40 stage px, or reduce that glyph's rotation, so the whole ransom row sits inside the stage with a margin.
